notes.content: The successful completion of a Portfolio Review is necessary for entry into upper division Graphic Design coursework. The portfolio is comprised of work from ARTS 122 , ARTS 123 , ARTS 125 , MADT 206 , MADT 222 , MADT 283 , MADT 284 , and MADT 285 , or their articulated transfer equivalents. The portfolio is reviewed by Communication Design faculty.
